description: Heatmap présence : jour du mois × heure (nombre d'événements par créneau d'une heure)

data.url: http://fhome.frett27.internal:3000/sql/select extract(day from date_trunc('hour', arrow_cast(timestamp,'Timestamp(Microsecond,None)'))) as jour_du_mois, extract(hour from date_trunc('hour', arrow_cast(timestamp,'Timestamp(Microsecond,None)'))) as heure, count(*) as nb_evt from history where topic='home%2Fesp13%2Fsensors%2Fpresence' and year={{YEAR}} and month={{MONTH}} and payload='1' group by date_trunc('hour', arrow_cast(timestamp,'Timestamp(Microsecond,None)'))
